subject: colext inconsistent sites across years; camtrap sessioncol

messages.author: 99f110fd6fce388c
messages.subject: colext inconsistent sites across years; camtrap sessioncol
parts:
Hi,

Two questions here:

1) I think this might be a pretty basic question, but I haven't been able to find the answer (in a way that I could pick out the answer) either in the unmarked PDF or here in this group. I'm working on creating a multi-season model with camera trap data using the colext function. I have four years of data. The first year has data from 60 cameras. Subsequent years have data from 41-43 cameras, but it's not the all the same cameras "missing" from each year (some cameras went down for a year and then came back up, while others were taken down and stayed down). 

If I want to consider all four years of data, can I use all the sites that reach my threshold for number of days in a season? Or do I need to cut down and only use cameras that have sufficient data for each year that I'd like to consider?

2) My second question relates to the cameraOperation function in camtrap to make my unmarkedMultFrame object. For multi-year work, do I need to use sessionCol in the cameraOperation function? Right now I have data in a format that has a single row for every camera, representing the duration of their operational time (with down time included as problems). Should that be alright? I recognize this isn't specifically a question about unmarked and I've already posted it in the camtrap Google group--please ignore if inappropriate here. 

Thank you!

messages.author: 247b990d236a7af6
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] colext inconsistent sites across years; camtrap sessioncol
parts:
If a "camera" is equivalent to a "site" and you have values for the covariates in each year, why not just use all of the data?  (And I'm assuming you have covariates to be considered.)

Jim
